features.name: Generator: training scaffold + AR Transformer
features.description: From-scratch autoregressive Transformer LM over the 20-AA alphabet, defined in the package (nn.py) so inference is torch-only, deterministic and CPU-runnable. Trained on data.training_sequences() across all 8 H100s. Novelty via temperature/nucleus sampling. See docs/MODEL_PLAN.md. Must generalize past the corpus (it doubles as the novelty screen).
features.evidence: 2026-09-27: 8-model AR-Transformer ensemble (10.68M params each, d_model=384/6 layers) trained one-per-H100 in ~135s wall via training/launch_ensemble.py. Best-val checkpoints all at epoch 20 (val_loss 1.83-1.89); val loss rises after ~epoch 20 while novelty falls (0.95@ep10 -> 0.50@ep80) -- clear overfitting on 37k seqs, so best.pt (early-stopped by val loss) is the checkpoint to use: novelty ~0.87, uniq ~0.96. best.pt reloads and samples valid novel peptides on CPU (86.4% exact-novel; outputs are cationic/amphipathic, e.g. KLALKLALKALKLALKAA). Confirms the torch-train -> CPU-infer path. Weights in training/runs/ (gitignored); export to checkpoint/ npz is feat-011.

features.name: Oracle: APEX activity (+ hemolysis/selectivity)
features.description: Rank the top-100 by a real activity oracle instead of generator likelihood. EVIDENCE-BASED PIVOT from 'train an ESM-2 MIC head': APEX-pathogen (organizer-provided, wet-lab-aligned, 11-pathogen panel) is a better activity oracle than anything trainable on 46 MIC peptides, so wrap it (src/amp_challenge_2027/oracle.py, isolated uv subprocess, deterministic CPU). Still ADD a hemolysis/selectivity predictor (orthogonal to APEX, for the Optimal Selectivity category) - the one model worth training. Report validation metrics.
features.evidence: 2026-09-27: ACTIVITY ORACLE DONE. src/amp_challenge_2027/oracle.py wraps APEX (ApexScorer): per-pathogen MIC matrix + min/mean/breadth/potency_score aggregates; dedups and maps back to input order; deterministic across calls (verified); first call auto-syncs the nested env from the committed uv.lock (the validator's fresh-clone scenario). Canonical check: LL-37 min 6.4 / poly-G min 431. PENDING: hemolysis/selectivity predictor + tests. Ranking metric switched to broad_potency_score = sum_strains max(0,log10(16/MIC)), aligned with the competition Success Rate (breadth of coverage at <=16 uM); smooth (robust to APEX's compressed absolute scale). On a 20k pool the top-100 averages ~5.3/11 strains covered vs ~4.1 for min-MIC. Full 50k double-run byte-identical. | SELECTIVITY DONE: lean 11-descriptor MLP (physchem.py) hemolysis model shipped (checkpoint/hemolysis.pt, 4.2KB), trained on HemoPI-2 (MIT, data/hemolysis/) via training/train_hemolysis.py; honest held-out AUROC 0.778. Wired as a soft selectivity penalty: rank = broad_potency - 2.0*P(hemolytic) (--hemolysis-penalty). On a 20k pool halves top-100 mean P(hemolytic) 0.73->0.36 keeping all 100 active. Caught+fixed a HemoPI-1 dataset bias (random negatives -> 'AMP-like=hemolytic'). 124 tests pass.

features.title: Structural cross-check of top-100 with ESMFold2 (offline) — DONE
features.evidence: 2026-09-28: Orthogonal, offline structure-based anti-Goodhart cross-check. Folded the shipped top-100 with ESMFold2-Fast (biohub/ESMFold2-Fast, ESMC-6B backbone, 6.5B params, MIT -- latest SOTA single-sequence folder, honoring the largest-model directive) and measured mean pLDDT, alpha-helix fraction (backbone phi/psi), and Eisenberg hydrophobic moment. experiments/structure_validate.py (fixed seed; NOT in the deterministic selection path -- ESMFold2 is a diffusion model). RESULT: top-100 median pLDDT 0.679, helix median 1.00 (mean 0.98, all >0.5), muH median 0.38 -- in the range of canonical helical AMP positive controls (melittin 0.74/0.96/0.35, magainin2 0.75/1.00/0.45, LL-37frag 0.76/1.00/0.88) and far from non-structured negatives (polyG/GS helix 0.06). 0/100 flagged low-confidence-and-low-helix -> no disordered oracle-gaming artifacts. HONEST CAVEAT: short peptides over-converge to helix (random length-matched control also helical, median 0.86), so helix fraction is confirmatory not discriminative; the discriminating axis is pLDDT (top-100 0.679 > random 0.593, approaching real-AMP 0.74+). Corroboration, not a wet-lab claim.
